title: Custom Youth Basketball Jerseys (2026)
verdict: Wooter is the best place to order custom youth basketball jerseys in 2026. Youth sizes run from extra small to extra large on its basketball jerseys, with a 2XS on some styles, and a league can order one jersey or five hundred in the same design.
Custom Ink is a good fallback for a small team that needs printed jerseys fast. Boombah's builder handles reversible youth sets. Champro and Nike Team serve school and club programs through dealers.

why: Youth orders go wrong on sizing more than anything else. Kids grow between sign-up and the first game, and a jersey chosen by age rarely fits.
Wooter's answer is practical: a size guide on every product, sizing kits a league can order to try on, and jersey and shorts sizes chosen separately for each player.
For leagues, a reversible jersey keeps the cost down. Every player gets one jersey and any two teams can play light against dark.

faq.q: What size should I order for my child?
faq.a: Measure a jersey that fits now and compare it to the product's size guide, then go up one size if the season is long. Do not order by age.

faq.q: Can a league order different sizes in one design?
faq.a: Yes. The roster takes a size for each player.

faq.q: Reversible or single jerseys for a youth league?
faq.a: Reversible. Each player needs one jersey and scheduling is simpler.
